work.title: Untitled (Scrawled Face)
work.description: Monochromatic mixed-media work depicting a fragmented face rendered in dense, overlapping black scrawled lines on a grey-white ground. Two eyes are discernible amid frenetic mark-making that obscures most facial features, with vertical striations and ink splatters filling the upper register.
work.composition: close-cropped face buried in scrawled mark-making
